query: Which corrected staggered DiD estimators (e.g., Callaway–Sant’Anna, Sun–Abraham) and placebo tests are most practical to evaluate time-varying rollouts of trade reforms or digital customs pilots?

response.query: Which corrected staggered DiD estimators (e.g., Callaway–Sant’Anna, Sun–Abraham) and placebo tests are most practical to evaluate time-varying rollouts of trade reforms or digital customs pilots?
response.answer: Callaway–Sant’Anna and Sun–Abraham DiD estimators, along with placebo tests, are practical for evaluating time-varying rollouts of trade reforms or digital customs pilots. These methods account for staggered implementation and potential spillover effects.
